boundaries.boundary: ENOENT produces ERR_FNF=1 and file SANITISED_FULL_PATH not found for PEER_IP. Quiet only suppresses its log.
EACCES and uid/secure/world-readable policy denial always produce ERR_PERM=2 with cannot access PATH: strerror(EACCES).
Other open/fstat errors produce ERR_NOTDEF=0 with cannot read PATH: strerror(errno), independently of Rust ErrorKind.

Initial, post-OACK/window and retry read errors share bounded ERR_NOTDEF path/errno text. C finishes the current window preserving DATA/ERR order, then releases transfer/file state. Fault witnesses replace one actual file read syscall and must prove health/descriptor recovery.
C sanitises the filename before constructing/logging ERR, retaining only isprint bytes in the fixed C locale. It drops controls, DEL and high bytes.
snprintf size500 includes the final zero; maximum ERR has499 message bytes, one zero and4 header bytes. Long error text is truncated before logging and transmitting.
One bounded formatted message is shared by wire and MS_TFTP|LOG_ERR. A logging consumer can extract code/message from the RuntimeEvent without reformatting; quiet suppresses only code1.

WRQ gets code4 unsupported write request from peer; missing/empty/unclosed filename gets code4 empty filename in request from peer; missing/illegal mode gets code4 unsupported request from peer. Unknown opcodes and len<2 are silent.
Every nonempty packet from a foreign transfer peer gets code5 ignoring packet from peer (TID mismatch), preserving the correct source transfer socket.
Peer IP text omits port and appends %ifname for resolvable IPv6 scope. Single-port IPv6 avoids the separately recorded dedicated scoped bind defect and must still emit full error text.

Options/MTU use atoi and clamps, without separate ERR text branches. Dedicated transfer port exhaustion has only a LOG_ERR and no wire reply; allocation/fstat/read failures use bounded generic oops. Existing pathological MTU/undefined C behaviours retain their reference classification.

Exact image musl atoi wraps modulo32, recognises C whitespace and optional sign, stops at the decimal prefix and casts to unsigned before clamping. All recognised numeric options still receive OACK; block-size cap is EDNS limit+261 and no-blocksize skips its option.
fstat errors always follow oops even for ENOENT/EACCES, and close the opened fd. Inject one actual file metadata syscall error on each side.
